title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree Summary Judgment And The Text There Is No God But Allah

questions.question: Who is praised in this passage as the great human guide who points people to Allah?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What holy book is connected with his message here?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the passage say first about Allah?
questions.answer: Allah is the only god.

questions.question: What are two words used to show that Allah is one?
questions.answer: One and Unique.

questions.question: What are some things that make the Prophet’s witness strong?
questions.answer: His many miracles, his religion’s true teachings, his noble character, and the greatness of the Qur’an.

questions.question: Besides friends, whose words are said to support his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Even his enemies.

questions.question: About how many miracles are mentioned?
questions.answer: Hundreds.

questions.question: About how many true teachings in his religion are mentioned?
questions.answer: Thousands.

questions.question: What do the miracles do in the passage?
questions.answer: They show that he is truthful.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, gives strong proof that Allah is one.

questions.question: In this passage, what belief is being declared about Allah?
questions.answer: That only Allah deserves worship.

questions.question: How is Allah’s existence described?
questions.answer: It is necessary and certain.

questions.question: Who is called a great honor for people?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet given such high honor here?
questions.answer: Because he shows people the truth about Allah.

questions.question: Name one thing about the Prophet that is described as great.
questions.answer: His character.

questions.question: Name another thing connected to the Prophet that is described as great.
questions.answer: His religion.

questions.question: What shows that the Prophet was not only respected by followers?
questions.answer: Even his enemies admitted his high qualities.

questions.question: If many miracles support someone’s message, what does that help people believe?
questions.answer: That the message is true.

questions.question: Are the truths in his religion pictured as weak or bright and clear?
questions.answer: Bright and clear.

questions.question: What kind of scholars are mentioned from his community?
questions.answer: Scholars with proof and clear understanding.

questions.question: What can we infer from all these proofs joining together?
questions.answer: His witness about Allah is very trustworthy.

questions.question: What short faith statement begins the meaning of the passage?
questions.answer: That there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: Allah is one without any partner.

questions.question: Who gives witness to this truth in a very powerful way?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What book adds to the strength of his witness?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the spread of his religion?
questions.answer: It is broad and far-reaching.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s good qualities?
questions.answer: He had many excellent qualities.

questions.question: Why is the mention of enemies important here?
questions.answer: It shows that even people against him could not hide his greatness.

questions.question: What two big kinds of support are mentioned for his witness?
questions.answer: Miracles and the true teachings of his religion.

questions.question: Are these teachings described as confusing or certain?
questions.answer: Certain.

questions.question: Which group is connected with light in the passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family.

questions.question: Which group is named as agreeing with him from the beginning of Islam?
questions.answer: His Companions.

questions.question: What lesson should a student take from this passage?
questions.answer: We should trust the Prophet’s message about Allah because it is supported in many strong ways.

questions.question: Who is the only one worshipped according to this passage?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s being one?
questions.answer: His oneness is real and complete.

questions.question: Who is the human messenger highlighted here?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What makes his testimony special in this passage?
questions.answer: It is backed by many clear signs.

questions.question: What is one clear sign named in the passage?
questions.answer: His miracles.

questions.question: What is another support named besides miracles?
questions.answer: The true teachings in his religion.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his character?
questions.answer: It is very high and noble.

questions.question: How do we know his greatness was widely seen?
questions.answer: Even his enemies confirmed it.

questions.question: What does “agreement” among many believers and scholars suggest?
questions.answer: That they all recognized the same truth.

questions.question: Who are the three groups that agree with his witness?
questions.answer: His family, his Companions, and the scholars of his community.

questions.question: Why is it important that scholars are mentioned too?
questions.answer: It shows that thoughtful people with knowledge also support this truth.

questions.question: What truth do all these signs point to?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and is one.

questions.question: What is the biggest message of this passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, strongly teaches that Allah alone is God.

questions.question: What names in the passage show that Allah is not many gods?
questions.answer: One and Unique.

questions.question: Who is honored as a special pride for the world?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What four things connected to the Prophet are praised here?
questions.answer: The Qur’an, his religion, his many good qualities, and his character.

questions.question: What does it mean when even enemies speak well of someone’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: It means the truth is hard to deny.

questions.question: What number word is used for his miracles?
questions.answer: Hundreds.

questions.question: What number word is used for the truths in his religion?
questions.answer: Thousands.

questions.question: Are those truths shown as dim or shining?
questions.answer: Shining.

questions.question: What does the support of the Prophet’s family add to the message?
questions.answer: It adds strong agreement from people close to him.

questions.question: What does the support of the Companions add?
questions.answer: It adds agreement from the early believers who knew him.

questions.question: What does the support of the scholars add?
questions.answer: It adds careful proof and understanding.

questions.question: If many different groups all agree on one truth, what should we understand?
questions.answer: That the truth is firm and dependable.

questions.question: What truth about Allah is stated at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Only Allah is God.

questions.question: How is Allah’s existence described in the passage?
questions.answer: As certain and necessary.

questions.question: Who is the main person giving witness in this passage?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What makes the Qur’an important in this passage?
questions.answer: Its greatness helps show the truth of the Prophet’s message.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the size of his religion?
questions.answer: It is wide and far-reaching.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet himself?
questions.answer: He had many excellent qualities and beautiful character.

questions.question: What surprising group also confirmed his greatness?
questions.answer: His enemies.

questions.question: What kind of miracles are mentioned?
questions.answer: Clear and obvious miracles.

questions.question: What are the teachings in his religion like, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Bright, strong, and convincing.

questions.question: Which people are described as having light?
questions.answer: His family.

questions.question: Which people are described as having proofs and clear insight?
questions.answer: The scholars of his community.

questions.question: After reading the whole passage, what conclusion fits best?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s message about Allah’s oneness is supported by strong proof and wide agreement.
